prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single 3D object icon for the Jifen sports utility app. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES only, not edit targets. Match this supplied Figma sports icon library exactly in visual language: detailed physically rendered miniature real objects, subtle satin and matte micrograin materials, softly rounded but realistic geometry, diffuse upper-left studio light, restrained highlights, natural saturated object colors. Not clay, not cartoon emoji, not flat vector. Mostly front view with a subtle three-quarter tilt and clear physical depth. Square 1024x1024 composition, one centered coherent object/group occupying about 78% of the canvas with ample transparent edge padding. A genuinely transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the object, no pedestal, no scene, no text labels, no border, no watermark. Keep a clear silhouette legible at small app icon size. Subject: flip-a-coin utility. ONE golden brass coin, large circular face viewed slightly from the side so the rounded milled rim and thickness are visible. A simple embossed five-point star on the face, believable smooth satin metal and subtle microtexture, softly warm gold, similar material fidelity to reference darts' brass. No currency writing, no floating extra coins.

iterations.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied single dice PNG. Correct ONLY the dice face pips: keep the front face exactly FIVE pips arranged four corners plus center, replace the top face's two pips with exactly ONE centered black recessed pip, keep the right face exactly THREE pips in a diagonal. These three adjacent faces must be 5, 1, 3 so the object can be a real standard die. Keep the entire cube shape, angle, size, position, ivory-white finely textured satin plastic, round edges, lighting, shadows within object and style unchanged. Preserve the genuinely transparent RGBA background. Clean the object alpha edge of any colored fringe, tiny stray dots or white halo. No new objects, text, floor, cast shadow, background or watermark.
iterations.note: Corrected physically possible adjacent dice faces to 5/1/3.
